references.text: Joshua repeats the same assurance that all of the Lord's promises have been fulfilled as he delivers his farewell address to Israel.
God's word and promises are unchangeable and will always be fulfilled, in contrast to human lies.
At the temple dedication, Solomon confirms that not one word has failed from all the good promises the Lord gave through Moses.
The original promise to Abraham regarding land and blessing, now fulfilled through the distribution of the land.
God's covenant with Abraham to give his descendants the land from Egypt to the Euphrates, now fulfilled.
The Lord is a faithful God who keeps His covenant and shows mercy to those who love Him.
God's word does not return empty but accomplishes what He sends it to do.
All of God's promises find their 'yes' in Christ, confirming God's faithfulness in the fulfillment of His promises.
He who made the promise is faithful; this is an encouragement to hold fast to hope based on God's faithfulness.
